scope: The April 2011 Westport House exterior in County Mayo, including the Cassels entrance frontage, pedimented south face and terraced lake-facing west elevation.

references.filename: Westport House from the boating lake.JPG

originalReview.notes: The lakeside view records the darker west elevation, lower terrace, basement, sash hierarchy, parapet, slate roof and chimney stacks.
The south view shows the pediment, rusticated grey stone, projecting central bay, arched lower opening, stone finials and terrace balustrade.

quallaSearch.notes: The two exact Qualla files match Laurel Lodged’s own CC0 uploads. Their original camera timestamps give April 23, 2011. The lake photo caption says Easter Sunday, a one-day difference from its camera metadata. The modeled preservation era is Easter weekend 2011.
